_about: Drag-and-drop registration JSON for the ReAct Agent v2 node. 'node_blueprint' is the object to drop on the canvas (same shape as CORE_NODES_BLUEPRINT in app/services/dynamic_flow.py). 'palette' describes each field for the properties panel. 'name' MUST stay exactly 'Autonomous ReAct Agent v2' - that string is the NodeRegistry key.

node_blueprint.name: Autonomous ReAct Agent v2
node_blueprint.description: Autonomous agent that reasons step by step and calls tools until it can answer. Typed tool arguments, durable session memory, iteration budget and honest COMPLETED/INCOMPLETE/FAILED status.

fields.help: 'llama3' routes to meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct on OPENAI_BASE_URL; gemini-* go to Vertex AI.

fields.label: User Query
fields.help: The question for this turn. Leave as {{CHAT_QUERY}} for chat flows.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.default: You are a helpful autonomous agent. Use the tools provided when you need real data.
fields.help: Persona and policy. Six built-in operating rules are appended automatically.

fields.label: Tools
fields.help: Each entry becomes a callable tool. Leave empty for a memory-aware chat agent.

fields.label: Memory Window (turns)
fields.help: How many previous human turns to keep in context. 0 disables history.

fields.label: Memory Source
fields.help: auto = checkpoint + MongoDB, richest wins (recommended) | state = checkpoint only | db = MongoDB only (use when the UI rotates thread_id) | off = stateless.

fields.label: Sticky Context
fields.help: Extra facts pinned into every turn, e.g. 'Customer: {{customer_name}}, Plan: {{plan_name}}'.

fields.label: Persist Memory
fields.help: Save every turn to MongoDB 'react_agent_memory' so memory survives new threads and restarts.

fields.label: Max Reasoning Steps
fields.help: Think -> Act cycles allowed. The loop stops itself before any recursion error. Also your cost ceiling.

fields.label: Response Format
fields.help: html renders nicely in chat bubbles; json when the next node parses the answer.

fields.label: Return Reasoning Trace
fields.help: Also outputs {{<output>_trace}} with every tool call and observation.

fields.label: Fallback Answer
fields.default: I could not complete that request. Could you rephrase it?
fields.help: Shown only if the agent and the recovery step both fail.

outputs.label: Output Variable
outputs.help: Name of the flow variable that receives the final answer.

_rules: 'name' must be exactly 'Autonomous ReAct Agent v2' - the compiler looks up NodeRegistry by node['name'].
'type' must NOT be start / output / outputs / conditions / iterator / agentflow / inputs - those are reserved by the compiler. Use 'agent'.
Only 'model', 'user_query' and 'outputParameters' are truly required; every other input has a safe default.
Edges use {'from': node_id, 'to': node_id}. Wire Start -> this node -> your next node.
Keep session_id stable across turns for memory; thread_id may rotate when memory_mode is 'auto' or 'db'.
